# Internet Archive

> > A digital library offering universal access to books, movies, software, music, websites, and more through collections like the Wayback Machine.

The Internet Archive preserves digital content and provides free access to millions of items including historical web pages, texts, audio recordings, videos, and software. Users can browse collections, download materials using tools like wget and the Internet Archive Command-line Tool, and search archived websites through the Wayback Machine.

## Key Topics

- Wayback Machine
- Internet Archive Command-line Tool
- wget
- Collections browsing
- File downloading
- Bulk download
- Advanced search
- Digital preservation
- PDF and ePub formats
- URL archiving
- Command-line tools
- Python utilities
- Historical manuscripts
- Web archiving

## Getting Started

- [Introductory Tour of Archive.org and its Collections](https://help.archive.org/help/introductory-tour-of-archive-org-and-its-collections/): Getting started guide to Archive.org collections and navigation basics

## Wayback Machine

- [Wayback Machine Advanced Search](https://archive.org/web/web-advancedsearch.php): Wayback Machine advanced search with URL and date range filtering

## Downloading and Tools

- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Guide to downloading files using wget, Python command-line tool, and bulk options

## Optional

- [Peresopnytsia Gospel 1556-1561](https://archive.org/details/PY1561): Peresopnytsia Gospel 16th-century Ukrainian manuscript with transliteration
